about.description:
EccoPy separates convective from stratiform radar echo using the ECCO
(Echo Classification from COnvectivity) algorithm, in four variants
covering 1-D series, vertical cross-sections, horizontal composites
and full 3-D volumes. It operates purely on NumPy arrays and performs
no file I/O, making it independent of coordinate system, file format
and radar type. The classification path is ported from the reference
MATLAB ECCO-V and C++ ConvStratFinder implementations developed at the
NSF National Center for Atmospheric Research.
about.summary: Data-agnostic Python implementation of the ECCO radar echo classification algorithm

script: python -c "from eccopy.core.classification import _DISK_STREL_DIR, _DISK_DECOMP_DIR; import os; assert os.listdir(_DISK_STREL_DIR); assert os.listdir(_DISK_DECOMP_DIR)"

python -c "import numpy as np; from eccopy import eccopy3d; from eccopy.params import WindowSpec; z=np.linspace(0.5,9,8); d=12-0.9*z[:,None,None]+np.zeros((8,20,20)); d[:,8:14,8:14]+=28; r=eccopy3d.run(d,coords_z=z,coords_y=np.linspace(-10,10,20),coords_x=np.linspace(-10,10,20),window=WindowSpec((5,'km'))); assert np.isin(r.echo_type,[1,2,3,14,16,18,25,30,32,34,36,38]).any()"

name: eccopy
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "1.0.1"

package:
  name: eccopy
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/e/eccopy/eccopy-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 860a975f832dad0c22a0b7ada4e97b4c8c53b643733718cf99b3b0d1361aec04

build:
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=1.24
    - scipy >=1.10
    - numba >=0.58

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - eccopy
        - eccopy.eccopy1d
        - eccopy.eccopy2d_v
        - eccopy.eccopy2d_h
        - eccopy.eccopy3d
        - eccopy.stats
      pip_check: true
      python_version: 
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
      
  - script:
      # The package ships small .mat reference arrays as package data.
      # Confirm they are installed: without them the enlarge_conv and
      # enlarge_mixed code paths fail at runtime.
      - python -c "from eccopy.core.classification import _DISK_STREL_DIR, _DISK_DECOMP_DIR; import os; assert os.listdir(_DISK_STREL_DIR); assert os.listdir(_DISK_DECOMP_DIR)"
      # End-to-end smoke test through the 3-D classifier.
      - python -c "import numpy as np; from eccopy import eccopy3d; from eccopy.params import WindowSpec; z=np.linspace(0.5,9,8); d=12-0.9*z[:,None,None]+np.zeros((8,20,20)); d[:,8:14,8:14]+=28; r=eccopy3d.run(d,coords_z=z,coords_y=np.linspace(-10,10,20),coords_x=np.linspace(-10,10,20),window=WindowSpec((5,'km'))); assert np.isin(r.echo_type,[1,2,3,14,16,18,25,30,32,34,36,38]).any()"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/iancornejo/EccoPy
  summary: Data-agnostic Python implementation of the ECCO radar echo classification algorithm
  description: |
    EccoPy separates convective from stratiform radar echo using the ECCO
    (Echo Classification from COnvectivity) algorithm, in four variants
    covering 1-D series, vertical cross-sections, horizontal composites
    and full 3-D volumes. It operates purely on NumPy arrays and performs
    no file I/O, making it independent of coordinate system, file format
    and radar type. The classification path is ported from the reference
    MATLAB ECCO-V and C++ ConvStratFinder implementations developed at the
    NSF National Center for Atmospheric Research.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  documentation: https://github.com/iancornejo/EccoPy#readme
  repository: https://github.com/iancornejo/EccoPy

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - iancornejo
